Who We Are

One team, every trade, start to finish.

KBHI Home Improvement handles a renovation from foundation to final coat — kitchens, bathrooms, siding, roofing, framing, and custom woodwork, all under one crew. No subcontractor hand-offs and no lost details in translation — just one team that sees a project through from the first stud to the final walkthrough.
